subject: Re: VeraHealth trial — request for short bridge while PO clears
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@verahealth.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-11T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Trial access for VeraHealth — provisioning question

Hi David,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team loved the latency numbers. We're ready to run a week-long integration smoke test against our staging data, but our procurement team just flagged an invoice validation step that is going to push the PO approval out by ~10 business days.

Can Redwood extend our trial environment or provide a short-term token/top-up so the engineers can finish the end-to-end checks? We're trying to avoid losing momentum with the exec stakeholders. If helpful, I can loop in procurement and share the invoice reference.

Appreciate any flexibility you can offer.

— Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Director of Engineering, VeraHealth
alyssa@verahealth.com

[Attachment: integration_plan.md (text/markdown)]

From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@verahealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-11T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial access for VeraHealth — provisioning question

Hi Alyssa —

Really glad the walkthrough landed well. We can absolutely help keep things moving. I can offer a short 7-day trial top-up (equivalent to 100k tokens) today to cover the smoke tests while procurement finishes their review.

If you expect the PO to clear in >7 business days, tell me the expected window and I can escalate for an extended bridge. Also please CC procurement on the follow-ups so we can see the invoice reference.

Camila — looping you in to track usage and make sure we don't accidentally exceed the trial allowances. Hannah — FYI on the escalation path if they need longer.

Next steps:
- Alyssa: confirm whether 7 days is enough or if you need 14.
- Procurement: please share the invoice/PO number if you want us to consider a longer bridge.

I attached a short SOW stub and the onboarding checklist for reference.

Best,
David
David Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf); onboard_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

Hi David/Alyssa,

Quick update from procurement — invoice INV-70821 is in legal's queue for one last verification because the vendor address and tax details need confirmation. The earliest we can expect sign-off is 10–12 business days. We can push to expedite but cannot promise under 7 business days.

Would a 14-calendar-day bridge solve the run-through for engineering? If so, please confirm and we will follow up on our side to accelerate.

Thanks,
Procurement Team

Thanks for the update, procurement team.

Alyssa — based on the expected 10–12 business day window, I've approved a 14-calendar-day trial top-up effective immediately. Best,
